entities.name: Masumaro
entities.description: A kami on Kamigawa, the first human to live by the ways of the kami, once a human.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War in which Masumaro's descendants were active.

events.summary: Masumaro's spirit becomes a kami because his people revered him so.
events.quote: He was once so revered by his people that his spirit became a kami
